text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The first time I raced her
was a short while after enrolling.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um...!
I'm Win Variation!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Your races are just amazing, Orfe-san!
If it's cool with you, would you mind doing a practice run with me?!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, haah,
h-ha, wheeze...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It was overwhelming.
I couldn't even catch her shadow before I lost.
It made me realize: that's what a born protagonist looks like.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I was frustrated. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I'll work hard, work hard, work hard...
and one day, I'll definitely catch up to you...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yes, I swore that to myself.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*, *wheeze*, *pant*!
...*cough*, *cough*! *gag*...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Phew, phew...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I can still keep going...!
If I just try harder...!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Challenging it again and again,
and losing again and again.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The hours spent on solo training increased.
She went to the instructor for advice time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
This training didn't work either.
I wasn't suited for this one either, nor this one...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...! Aah, damn it, what am I supposed to do...?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I grew to hate the sight of that golden figure.
Day after day, I charged in full of bluster, only to be utterly crushed.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: It didn't take long for admiration to turn into hatred.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...
It doesn't even serve as fuel.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Work hard. ...Next.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I-I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If I work hard, then someday
even I could be like that...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, to run... like that...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Before she knew it, "effort" had shifted from being a source of hope to an emotional talisman.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...A dream?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Hm? Huh? What was that dream about again...?
Man, I feel so exhausted.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...I'll go for a run to clear my head.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Phew... haah...
Hm... alright, time for some stretch—

Haaaaaaaaaaaaah!!
Daaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Looking closely at the turf,
there was Verxina,
chasing after Gentildonna's back.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "A composed Gentile-san and a desperate Verxina-san. What was once only a slight gap began to widen, bit by bit—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(They just keep... getting further...
...and further... and further away...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (What the... They're just like me and Orfevre.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, idiot!
What am I thinking...?!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Aah, daaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Before anyone realized it, the gap had closed.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I was right behind Ms. Gentile.
When she accelerated, I accelerated too,
closing the gap more and more—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"The sight of her running straight ahead into the light...
was so, so very—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: They were... shining.......

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (I didn't make it. But—)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Ho-ho, you spoke of tandem running,
so I wondered what to expect, but to think it was this...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...No, but I felt it.
Closer than ever before... you...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: The brilliance of the Tiara that rightfully belongs to me!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Ha... haha...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (......What is it, Verxina-san...?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible, truly impressive...
...She really is amazing—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (And to think we were drinking apple juice together just a moment ago.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Please, don't push yourself any harder.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aah!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...!
I'm the worst, the absolute worst...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm sorry...!
I'm so sorry...! I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Why... why did this have to happen...
To someone who's trying so hard... trying to achieve her dream..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I'll work hard, work hard, work hard...
and one day, I'll definitely catch up to you...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: To do... something like that...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
…………
The moment you think that, ……it's over, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh... ah.
...Ahhh...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I-I have to... find the words,
scream them, let them all out—!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Something, anything...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (What——... what?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...—That's right.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(—The truth is, I knew from the very beginning.
I knew, but I just ignored it.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (I kept telling myself that effort pays off and believed it, holding onto hope like a lucky charm, giving it my all.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (I kept clinging on, and this is the pathetic state it got me into.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I-It's impossible.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...That's enough. I can't take this anymore.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Just let me accept it already.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: She is the true star.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I can't reach it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the morning, when I arrived at the Trainer's Room,
Win Variation was waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
Please let me retire from racing after the Nikkei Sho.
